# ZYXEN

> ZYXEN is a digital solutions and creative engineering agency based in Hyderabad, India. We design and build high-performance web applications, aviation academy mock exam platforms, pharmaceutical production management software, and custom business automation systems.

## Core Capabilities
- High-Performance Web Engineering: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, edge delivery, ultra-fast TTFB, optimized Core Web Vitals, accessible semantic UI.
- Aviation Academy Software: Pilot mock exam portals configured for DGCA (India), FAA (USA), and EASA (Europe) examination rules, student fee ledgers, admissions CRM, and institute ERP.
- Production Management Systems: Real-time batch tracking, raw material lot traceability, WHO-GMP and CDSCO Schedule M compliance audit trails, and multi-unit inventory control for pharmaceutical and bulk drug manufacturers.
- Cloud & Systems Architecture: Scalable microservices, fault-tolerant database design, API engineering, and automated cloud deployments.
- Custom Software & Workflow Automation: Business process automation, quotation generation engines, client portals, and bespoke administrative dashboards.
